summary: The candidate talks about rent through neighbors and blocks, in the words of someone who has watched people leave, and keeps the policy to one plain ask.
realLife: Council and mayoral candidates in Austin, Providence and New Bedford spoke of neighbors displaced when new buildings came in, rents rising far faster than the landlord's own costs, and housing costs outrunning pay. The asks were short: cap the yearly increase, build more, or ease the burden on elderly renters.
sources: Misael Ramos, Alexandria Anderson and Steven Brown, Austin city council District 1 candidates, housing forum (as reported by CBS Austin): https://cbsaustin.com/news/local/story/austin-city-council-district-1-candidates-pitch-housing-affordability-plans-at-forum
Providence mayoral candidate, housing plan rollout (as reported by the Providence Journal): https://news.yahoo.com/rent-stabilization-providence-mayoral-candidate-150655094.html
